'''Parren''' was a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] and [[Scientist/Legends|Scientist]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], Parren believed that she found a way to domesticate the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]], a hostile bug-like species native to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. However, she needs a live specimen to continue her research. She tasked a Republic spacer to subdue a Killik and bring it back to her.
